feeds.title: Spoonflower Blog
feeds.description: The Spoonflower Blog is a collaborative space for creative people from around the world to discover new possibilities and create something wonderful together. Spoonflower's mission is to give people who make unique things with fabric greater power to express themselves and to make their work available to others.

feeds.title: Art Gallery Fabrics Blog
feeds.description: The creative blog of the Miami based textile manufacturing company, Art Gallery Fabrics. Discussing sewing, quilting, and tutorials. In 2004, our desire to bring a chic and modern perspective to the quilting industry is what inspired us to start Art Gallery Fabrics. Since then creativity, beauty, and design have been our passions. And to this day, they have not changed.

feeds.title: Jolly Jabber Blog
feeds.description: The Jolly Jabber is dedicated to cultivating a crafty lifestyle for quilters, sewists, crafters, and fabric enthusiasts alike. We can't wait to share our ideas and see yours, too!

feeds.title: Mood Designer Fabrics Sewciety Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about beginner sewing, patternmaking, accessory patterns, sewing tips and tricks, sewing machine care and more. Mood Fabrics is the number-one shopping destination for fashion fabric in the world.

feeds.title: Colorways by Vicki Welsh Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my little corner of the internet where I blog and sell hand dyed fabrics and fused glass. Here on the site you will find my fabric and glass shops, loads of free tutorials and my daily blog.

feeds.title: Kapok Natural Fiber Organic
feeds.description: We Are the No.1 Organic Kapok Supplier that produces from Indonesia. pure from High-Quality Natural Ingredients and processed by Talented Humans.

feeds.title: Fabric Mart Fabricistas Blog
feeds.description: Fabric Mart has been in business for over 40 years. Our web store was developed in 1999 to meet the needs of our customers.

feeds.title: Fabrics Store Blog
feeds.description: Covers tutorials, style news, success hacks and linen information. Fabrics Store is a collective of individuals passionate about their crafts.

feeds.title: Fort Worth Fabric Studio Blog
feeds.description: We are a fun & vibrant online-only quilt shop! Our exclusive fat quarter bundles are favorites among customers across the country! We carry premium, 100% cotton quilting fabric from all the major manufacturers in the industry. With new fabric arriving daily, we are never short on inspiration and ideas - we love what we do!

feeds.title: Shannon Fabrics Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Sewciety, the Shannon Fabrics blog. At Shannon Fabrics it's simple, our passion lies in making the world a softer place. And with Sewciety, we are really excited to share that passion with you! So, when we find really cool projects, patterns, tutorials and videos we will share them. At Sewciety, you will also find out about our newest fabrics, free patterns, contests and giveaways too!

feeds.title: Raspberry Creek Fabric Blog
feeds.description: Do you love to sew and create unique clothing and fabric items tailored just for you?! Browse the Raspberry Creek Fabrics blog to jump start your creative side and get creating with our high quality retail and custom fabrics.

feeds.title: The Shapes of Fabric Blog
feeds.description: A blog about pattern making and fabric manipulation, the more creative and fun side of drafting patternmaking.

feeds.title: Kokka Fabric
feeds.description: This is the official blog of KOKKA, a Japanese textile manufacturer known for its high quality and printed fabrics. Up-to-date info, tips for fabric crafts. Kokka Co., Ltd. is a Japanese textile manufacturer and wholesaler known worldwide for its printed fabrics. We have a huge selection of textiles to meet every need and requirement.

feeds.title: Lella Boutique Blog
feeds.description: When life is scrappy, make a quil. I've got my mother to blame; she shared her sewing and design knowledge with me since I was a little girl. It started with playing in her fabric stash and evolved to a full-blown quilt addiction by the time I was a teenager.

feeds.title: Surge Fabric Shop Blog
feeds.description: Surge Fabric Shop's sewing blog is devoted to sewing tutorials and hacks. Surge Fabric Shop is a small, family run business that operates out of Lebanon, MO. We launched our first web-presence on Etsy in 2016. Since then, we have migrated to our own website to provide a better shopping experience for our customers.

feeds.title: Style Maker Fabrics
feeds.description: Style maker fabrics - your online source for high-quality apparel fabrics in the fashion colors and trends you love. We are a small family-run business dedicated to providing today's sewist fabrics, tools, and inspiration for creating handmade garments that match their unique style.

feeds.title: Pine Crest Fabrics Blog
feeds.description: See the latest news and knowledge in the textile industry here. From fabric knowledge to eco-friendly news, Pine Crest Fabrics is the way to go! Pine Crest Fabrics, Inc. is a spandex fabric wholesaler that offers a large variety of stretch fabrics, both stocked and custom made.

feeds.title: The Fabric Store Blog
feeds.description: Find endless sewing inspiration on our blog with sew-alongs, pattern reviews, DIY and scrapbusting project ideas and more! The Fabric Store is the destination for the #memade sewing and creative community in Australasia.

feeds.title: Gorgeous Fabrics' Blog
feeds.description: At Gorgeous Fabrics, we aim to inspire, teach and promote fine sewing and sewing skills to all levels of sewing enthusiasts! Love fabric? Love sewing? A little scared of sewing? Want to improve your sewing skills? You've come to the right place!

feeds.title: Faith and Fabric Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Faith and Fabric, the place where we create and share the beauty of our faith through gorgeous quilts and fabrics! We believe that there is something very personal in creating lovely handmade item that reflects and retains a bit of you that wasn't there before.

feeds.title: Fabric Architecture Magazine
feeds.description: Fabric Architecture inspires and educates readers about the benefits of fabric as an innovative building material. Each e-newsletter contains case studies, market trends, and news about the fabric architecture industry.

feeds.title: Lamazi Fabrics Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Lamazi Fabrics blog. In this creative space we share sewing tips, tutorials and inspiration from fellow seamstresses in the sewing community. Lamazi Fabrics is an online fabric boutique of designer fabrics and patterns for dressmaking and crafts.

feeds.title: Specialty Fabrics Review
feeds.description: Specialty Fabrics Review, Industrial Fabrics Association International's flagship magazine, is the definitive voice of the industry. In print since 1915, it is one of the longest-running magazines in the United States.

feeds.title: Poppie Cotton Blog
feeds.description: Poppie Cotton is all about beautiful fabric and lovely goods. Poppie Cotton manufactures 100% fine cotton quilting fabric in Korea. The Poppie Cotton Blog features creative sewing and quilting projects using their fabric collections, highlighting designer collaborations, and offering inspiration for crafting versatile and stylish items.

feeds.title: Good Fabric Blog
feeds.description: The Good Fabric blog, sewing projects, stitching sessions and sustainability. Good Fabric is UK online fabric store, stocking eco-friendly dressmaking fabrics, ex-designer deadstock, indie sewing patterns and sustainable haberdashery.

feeds.title: Fabric406 Blog
feeds.description: Fabric406's blog is where you can find information about quilting plus new fabrics and quilt kits that are available in the shop! Fabric406's goal is to provide you with quality, affordable and beautiful patterns and fabrics so you can do what you do best - Create!

feeds.title: Fabric Online Store Blog
feeds.description: A fabric blog, centered around preppy fabrics like madras plaid, patchwork madras, seersucker, and prints, and also with lots of information and articles on sewing, crafts, quilting, handmade clothing and stitching.Fabric Online Store is a one-stop-shop for everything in Fabrics, especially preppy madras plaid, patchwork madras, bleeding madras and plaid fabrics.

feeds.title: Croft Mill
feeds.description: Croft Mill source from both local and international designers and manufacturers to bring you amazing and unique stock. Most of their stock is manufacturing ends and sampling lengths from both top end and high street designers. They aim, in all of their descriptions of the fabrics to make it clear about the quality and value of each of them.

feeds.title: Zen Chic Blog
feeds.description: Zen Chic's blog, where Brigitte Heitland talks about new fabrics, quilt patterns, freebies and some personal things going on in her life. With a fresh and modern approach to quilt design, Zen Chic adds a sophisticated and clear style to your home. The quilts are inspired by simplicity and pureness, and the enhancement by Brigitte's own fabrics make them unique and sparkling.

feeds.title: A Bit of Scrap Stuff
feeds.description: A bit of sewing, quilting, and fabric! I am a gal who LOVES my family plus fabric, quilting, sewing, cross stitch, and embroidery! I love creating projects that my family and friends can use. This blog shares a bit of my fabric and thread creations plus random things too- just to keep it interesting.

feeds.title: Jennifer Sampou Blog
feeds.description: Jennifer Sampou Fabric Designer, Author, Speaker. It is my passion to design fabrics that inspire you to create things that make your home uniquely you.

feeds.title: Cotton Candy Fabrics Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Cotton Candy Fabrics Blog - A place to hang out and get ideas from your friends at Cotton Candy Fabrics.

feeds.title: Little Fabric Shop Blog
feeds.description: Here at Little Fabric Shop, we love to sew! Our blog is filled with sewing tutorials and fabric inspiration to help energize your projects. We regularly add to our blog, so check back often for our latest tips, tools, and tutorials. Little Fabric Shop is a Modern Fabric Shop for Joyful Sewing.

feeds.title: Cloud9 Fabrics Blog
feeds.description: Cloud9 Fabrics uses only 100% certified organic cotton in the manufacturing of our base cloths and eco-responsible low impact dyes for printing and dying. We work closely with mills that are committed to ethical and responsible conduct.

feeds.title: Hawthorne Threads Blog
feeds.description: We are a husband and wife owned company offering a vast selection of modern fabrics and notions, along with our own digitally printed fabric and wallpaper. At Hawthorne Supply Co. we are passionate about supplying you with the tools for a creative life!

feeds.title: Making It Fun
feeds.description: A blog about sewing, quilting, fabric, crafting and DIY.

feeds.title: The Ardent Thread
feeds.description: I've been sewing since 1978, researching Japanese textiles since 2004, blogging on The Ardent Thread since January 1, 2008, and writing for publications such as Stitch Magazine since 2010. I teach, lecture, sell, and collect as many beautiful textiles (and books about them) as I can. Following the threads of weavers long past, I aim to unravel their techniques and learn patience and perseverance along the way.

feeds.title: Fabric Blog
feeds.description: Fabric UK is a family-run fabric business since 1968. With regular purchasing and regular fabric imports coming into their warehouse, their shelves are replete with a wide range and variety of fabrics and products for all types of projects. Head to their blog which features posts on topics such as work projects, product details, product reviews, Fashion, and Style, latest designs, trending patterns, and more similar subjects.

feeds.title: Birch Fabrics Blog
feeds.description: Birch Organic Fabrics was created in an effort to provide an environmentally friendly cotton alternative to the quilting and crafting community. We at Birch Fabrics believe that the sustainability of our planet begins with consciousness, and can be successful with real action.

feeds.title: Confessions of a Fabric Addict
feeds.description: A quilting blog talking about charity quilting, personal quilting, and sometimes just a bit of life. Welcome to my blog and thanks for stopping by! I'm Sarah, and my crafting passion is quilting.

feeds.title: HZCORK Blog
feeds.description: Original Manufacturer Of Cork Vegan Fabric & Cork Bags. Everything you need to know about this wonderful gift from Nature Here you can find content about our natural cork fabric, cork bags, cork wallets and more

feeds.title: Modern Domestic Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about new product updates and general sewing fun, fabrics, machine service, and more. Modern Domestic transforms substance into style through a curated fabric selection, instruction for sewists of all stripes, and an inspiring emphasis on community.

feeds.title: The Social Fabric
feeds.description: I'm Nisan, a 24 year old sociology grad student based in Ankara, Turkey. I share all my creations and daily musings about sewing over on Instagram, but recently I have been feeling the need for more space to talk about my projects, hence why I started this blog. I will be providing extensive detail on fitting, techniques, materials and my feelings & thoughts regarding all my projects right here; along with reviews and general chattiness.

feeds.title: Treadle Yard Goods
feeds.description: Treadle Yard Goods is a full service fabric store specializing in natural fiber fabrics for apparel. We carry a well-curated collection of gorgeous fabrics including silk, wool, linen, rayon, cotton, oilcloth, and bridal laces.

feeds.title: Fabric Mutt
feeds.description: My name is Heidi Staples, and I'm so glad you're here! I love to sew, design fabric, write sewing patterns, and spend time with my sweet family here in the Texas Hill Country.

feeds.title: Quarter Inch Mark
feeds.description: My name is Chase. I have been inquired less fabrics and my simple goal is using what I have around.

feeds.title: Merchant & Mills
feeds.description: Carolyn Denham and Roderick Field began merchant & mills in 2010 with the intention of bringing style and purpose to the overlooked world of sewing. Merchant & Mills continues to grow steadily, evolving and developing as experience and ideas demand. Carolyn and Roderick now travel the world in search of unique and beautiful fabrics, finding aesthetic and practical inspiration along the way.

feeds.title: Alice Caroline Blog
feeds.description: Liberty fabric, patterns and more. Alice Caroline are Liberty fabric specialists. We sell beautiful Liberty fabric, patterns, notions and kits. Alongside traditional archive prints, new designs and colour palettes are created in the renowned Liberty design studio for each of the seasonal collections.

feeds.title: Laura Wasilowski
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Laura Wasilowski, and I combine vivid fabrics and whimsical stories to make my pictorial art quilts. My colorful, hand-dyed fabrics inspire me, as do stories of my family, friends, and home. These pieces often chronicle my life. At Artfabrik, we provide you with high-quality, colorful hand-dyed fabrics and threads that pleasure you.

feeds.title: Betty Jo's Blog
feeds.description: Adventures in Fabric Art. Hi everyone! My goal for this site is to share my work and techniques for making quilted art so that it brings a lot of enjoyment and how-to information to my readers.
